newsitem.title: SPAIN: Lisbon air cargo up 0.1 pct in Jan-Oct 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon air cargo up 0.1 pct in Jan-Oct 1996.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Lisbon airport rose 4.7 percent in October to 9,388 tonnes, the Portuguese airports authority ANA said.
The 10 month total of 81,930 tonnes is just 0.1 percent ahead of the same period last year.
Passenger numbers at Lisbon were 2.7 percent higher than the same month last year at 562,763, or 5.52 million in the 10 month period, an increase of 2.3 percent.

Cargo business at Porto, the country's second biggest air freight airport, was up 7.2 percent in October at 2,646 tonnes taking the accumulated total to 20,940 tonnes, 3.4 percent higher than 1995. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7707 Fax+44-171-542-5017
